en.body: Covariance and contravariance explain how one type-former layer transports occurrences, but sign parity does not characterize strict positivity. Within each constructor-argument type, a recursive occurrence of I is forbidden in the domain of any nested Π or arrow; type formers preserve admissibility only in parameters explicitly accepted as strictly positive by the positivity policy. Thus sup : Π a : A, (B a → W A B) → W A B is accepted: (B a → W A B) is one outer constructor argument, and its recursive W occurs in the codomain of the inner arrow. By contrast, an argument W → A is rejected, as is the double-negative continuation ((W → A) → A).

zh-CN.body: 协变与反变可以解释一层类型构造器如何传递出现位置，但符号翻转的奇偶不能刻画严格正性。在每个构造参数类型内部，递归出现的 I 不得位于任何嵌套 Π 或箭头的定义域中；只有正性策略明确认可为严格正的类型构造器参数才保持可接受性。因此 sup : Π a : A, (B a → W A B) → W A B 合法：B a → W A B 是一个完整的外层构造参数，而递归出现的 W 位于其内部箭头的值域。相反，参数 W → A 不合法，双重负位置的 continuation ((W → A) → A) 也仍不合法。
